product_metadata.title: catalpa yao Cotton Rope Woven Basket Large, Woven Blankets Storage with Handles, Toys and Nursery Laundry,22x14 Inch XXXL (White & Light Brown)
features: 22"x14" extra large cotton rope basket provides an enough space for both big things like pillows and blankets, and small things like diapers, clothes or other home sundries, helping you keep everything organized.

Made of 100% cotton rope with no chemicals, this nursery basket is super safe and soft for kids, pets or clothes, even friendly for sensitive skins, and at the same time, can hold its shape and stand up on its own.

With sturdy handles on both sides, this woven basket is easy to carry and move. Collapsible design allows you to easily fold it up for storage when not in use, a perfect replacement for traditional paper or plastic box.

A collocation of neutral colors and classic round shape make this laundry basket a wonderful art craft in living room or bedroom to match any decoration style. Even carried as a bag when holding clothes to laundry room, it can be your good fashion accessory.
Due to a long-distance shipping and folded packing, please forgive some unavoidable creases. Just fill it up and use for some time, then the basket will restore its perfect condition.
